title: Pan-Seared Weakly Hash with Asparagus and Brined Sausage
description: A hearty breakfast dish featuring pan-seared weakly hash, asparagus, and a side of brined Slovakian sausage
instructions: 1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the weakly hash to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 4-5 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, cook the asparagus in the microwave or on the stovetop until tender.
4. Add the brined Slovakian sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
5. If using eggs, crack them into the skillet and scramble them with the weakly hash.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
7. Serve the weakly hash with the asparagus and brined Slovakian sausage on the side.
8. If desired, top with butter and serve hot.
